title: Gate HP regain and stabilization while a dying character cannot breathe (rule:suffocating)
description:
Problem. SRD rule:suffocating: the creature 'drops to 0 hit points and is dying, and it can't regain hit points or be stabilized until it can breathe again.' For characters, nothing in hpLifecycle.ts gates recovery on breathing: record_death_save stabilizes on a third success and restores 1 HP on a natural 20; stabilize_character and adjust_hp healing are not blocked. Death saves are engine-owned (never tracked in prose), so the DM cannot avoid the contradiction by skipping the tool. Current disclosure: RULE_KNOWN_LIMITS rule:suffocating with capability gap 'suffocation-recovery-gate'.

Required capability. Operation: a persisted per-character 'cannot regain hit points / cannot be stabilized' gate entered with the suffocation drop to 0 HP and cleared when the DM records that the character can breathe again; while set, record_death_save does not stabilize or restore HP (three successes and natural 20 handled per the gate), stabilize_character and HP regain are refused, and a stable recovery deadline is not armed. Inputs: character identity; enter/clear events. Exclusions: whether the creature can breathe (DM). Consider the same gate for other sources that forbid regaining HP.

Selection basis: the governing SRD clause requires an engine-owned step (ADR 0020 §3: arithmetic / atomic state mutation / resource accounting / lifecycle), and no registered tool performs it. Under F-09 design amendment A5 (docs/design/rule-record-runtime-statements.md, PR #596) the rule's known limit only DISCLOSES this gap; it does not satisfy or retire the obligation. This bead blocks eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4 (owning rules work for opus:F-09 / sol:CAP-001) until the capability lands or accepted authority explicitly changes the requirement. Do not close it because PR #596 recorded the gap. Enters this engine family by explicit positive selection (the family's out-of-backlog entry clause).
acceptance_criteria:
- Persisted gate with enter/clear operations; record_death_save, stabilize_character, adjust_hp healing and the stable-recovery deadline respect it atomically.
- Tests for each gated path and for clearing the gate.
- rule:suffocating character clause rewritten under R0; gap entry removed from ENGINE_CAPABILITY_GAPS.
- eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4 dependency resolves only when this lands.
